title: SPYBOT V1 X Open Source and Keyless
features:
Total War Cheat (SPYBOT | Total War) - Feature List

I wanted to add some funny features, like Winner Cat (when you kill someone), but it didn't work correctly. If anyone found any fix, dm me on dc hxnrylsd. Aimbot and ESP working perfectly. Box Roundness looks like an German Symbol, but I'll fix that when I'm brain farting again.

Aimbot:
- Aim Enabled toggle (default ON)
- Aim Key (F by default, rebindable button)
- Aim Mode: Camera / Mouse
- Aim Toggle: Hold / Toggle
- Aim FOV slider (default 12)
- Aim Smoothing slider (default 15)
- Aim Sensitivity slider (default 0.80, max 1.00)
- Aim Team Check (skip teammates)
- Aim Visible Check / Wall Check (default ON)
- Aim Dead Check (default ON, skips dead/KO)
- Aim Priority: Nearest / Closest to Mouse / Both (composite score)
- Aim Low-HP bonus (weaker targets win ties)
- Prediction toggle + Lead slider (velocity-based leading, uses real frame dt)
- Sticky targeting (holds last target while valid)
- Kill credit via Humanoid.Died event (Winner Cat trigger)

ESP (Players):
- ESP Enabled
- Box ESP (full rectangle)
- Box Mode: Box / Corner brackets
- Box Roundness slider (emulated rounded corners via line path when SetRound unsupported)
- Name text
- Info text (distance/health)
- Health text
- Text Scale slider (default shows 1.0, internally x1.3 bigger)
- Text AA toggle
- Team Color toggle
- Team Check
- Wall Check (gray out when no line of sight)
- Highlight (enemies only, visible-only, Occluded depth mode)
- Dead Check (hide dead/KO)
- Tracers (singular line)
- Spawnpoint ESP (default OFF)

Visuals:
- Fullbright
- No Fog (classic + Atmosphere)
- No DoF / Blur (DepthOfFieldEffect + BlurEffect, lazily discovered)
- Potato Graphics (QualityLevel.Level01)
- Clear View (combined: Bloom x0.35, Godrays off, DoF/Blur off, Atmosphere x0.15)
- FOV Changer + FOV slider

Crosshair:
- Toggle + color picker

FOV Circle:
- Show FOV Circle toggle (default ON)
- Color picker
- Rendered as 64-segment line ring (solid, no transparency)

Winner Cat:
- Toggle (default ON)
- Spawns cat image (rbxassetid://8665513552) on credited kill
- Off-center (never screen middle)
- 1s visible + 3s fade
- Multiple cats supported

Startup:
- 10% chance easter egg (rbxassetid://6742954963), auto-dismiss 4s
- Notify on load (RightShift = UI, F = aim key)

Stealth / Safety:
- Zero remotes fired
- No hooks / no C-side overwrites
- Real-player filter: direct Workspace child + Humanoid + no SENHoneypot attribute
- All executor APIs (Drawing, SetRound, color pickers) pcall-guarded
- UI: Obsidian library (deividcomsono fork) via loadstring + HttpGet
- Addon loads (ThemeManager/SaveManager) pcall-guarded with nil-safe guards

UI / Config:
- RightShift toggles UI
- SaveManager / ThemeManager support (if available)
- Per-target ESP records with viewport culling (off-screen boxes hidden)
